metadata.title: The Consilience Framework: From Valuation Theory to the Void — A Cross-Domain Synthesis
metadata.description: Synthesis of two deep-dive research conversations (2026-08-04) on valuation theory and foundational mathematics. Traces the complete hierarchy from the void (unmarked state) through the calculus of distinctions (Laws of Form), ZFC set theory, and Ostrowski's theorem, arriving at a cross-domain consilience: Archimedean (continuous, additive) and non-Archimedean (ultrametric, hierarchical) measurement geometries represent the two fundamental modes of structure generation. Provides a Universal Consilience Prompt template for automated cross-domain translation of mathematical theorems, an autonomous four-phase LLM research workflow, and explicit mappings onto the QNFO WBS pillars.
